title: L2 Engineer - Platform & Agentic Ops
description:
About the Role

The L2 Engineer – Platform & Agentic Ops bridges core infrastructure operations, platform reliability, and autonomous AI agent operations (Agentic Ops). In this intermediate role, you act as the operational backbone for enterprise platforms hosting microservices, data workflows, and multi-agent AI systems. You will handle escalations from Level 1 support, diagnose platform anomalies, trace AI agent execution failures (e.g., tool-call loops, prompt regressions, and token overruns), and maintain high availability across cloud environments. This position works closely with Platform, DevOps, and AI/ML Engineering teams to automate runbooks, optimize agentic workflows, and maintain platform stability.

Responsibilities

* Agentic Ops & Telemetry Analysis: Monitor autonomous AI agents and execution runtimes. Debug multi-step agent workflows, handle failed tool calls/function calling, resolve context-window and token budget limits, and mitigate runaway loops or infinite retry chains.
* Platform Operations & Incident Management: Serve as an escalation point (L2) for production incidents, service degradations, and system alerts across Kubernetes clusters, API gateways, and cloud infrastructure.
* Observability & Distributed Tracing: Instrument and monitor end-to-end telemetry across both traditional infrastructure and LLM/agent pipelines (inspecting spans from prompt $\rightarrow$ routing $\rightarrow$ retrieval $\rightarrow$ tool execution).
* Automation & Runbook Engineering: Convert repetitive manual fixes into automated scripts, self-healing jobs, or standardized Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to empower L1 teams.
* Cost & Quota Governance: Track, manage, and enforce rate limits, model routing thresholds, and API credit/token consumption across foundation model providers and vector databases.
* CI/CD & Deployment Support: Assist in deploying, validating, and rolling back platform services, prompt configurations, agent definitions, and model gateway updates safely.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Partner with L3/core engineering teams on detailed post-mortems for major platform or agentic pipeline failures.

Requirements

* Experience: 2–4 years in Systems Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Platform Operations.
* Scripting & Programming: Proficiency in Python (essential for agent runtimes and automations) or Bash/Go/Node.js.
* Cloud & Containerization: Practical experience operating and debugging within containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Agentic & LLM Fundamentals: Foundational understanding of how LLMs and agent frameworks function—including tool/function calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, context window management, and prompt handling.
* Observability Stack: Hands-on experience with logging, metric, and tracing tools (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Networking & APIs: Solid grasp of REST APIs, gRPC, JSON schemas, webhooks, authentication (OAuth/IAM), and HTTP status debugging.
* Problem-Solving & Communication: Clear documentation skills, disciplined troubleshooting under SLA constraints, and effective cross-functional communication.

Nice to Have

* Agentic Framework Exposure: Direct operational experience with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
* LLM Tracing & Evaluation Tools: Familiarity with LLM observability tools such as LangSmith, Phoenix (Arize), Langfuse, or Weights & Biases.
* Vector Databases: Operational familiarity with vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma, pgvector).
* Workflow Orchestrators: Exposure to durable execution engines or workflow tools (e.g., Temporal, Airflow, Prefect).
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Basic knowledge of Terraform or Helm for managing platform components.
* Certifications: AWS Certified SysOps Administrator / Solutions Architect Associate, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), or cloud AI certifications.

# JOB DESCRIPTION

## Mechanical Design Engineer – SPM

\*\*Company:\*\* Synapse Robotics

\*\*Work Location:\*\* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

\*\*Travel Requirement:\*\* Willingness to travel to customer sites across India when required

\*\*Software:\*\* SolidWorks proficient with AI applicability

### 1. About Synapse Robotics

Synapse Robotics is an innovative industrial automation and robotics solutions company. Our out-of-the-box ideas, combined with a strong mechanical design and controls team, help us deliver reliable, safe and optimal automation solutions. Our experienced technicians support fabrication and assembly, enabling timely project execution and after-sales service.

We apply the latest technologies to deliver machines with high operating efficiency. Our three core values—\*\*Innovation, Excellence and Integrity\*\*—are embedded in our solutions and reflected in the way our employees work.

### 2. Job Purpose

The Mechanical Design Engineer – SPM is responsible for understanding customer requirements, developing mechanical concepts and completing detailed designs for Special Purpose Machines (SPMs) and industrial automation systems.

The role involves 3D modelling, manufacturing drawings, BOM preparation, design validation and coordination with fabrication, assembly, procurement and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, manufacturable and cost-effective solutions within project timelines.

### 3. Key Responsibilities

\*\*A. Customer Requirements and Concept Development\*\*

- Understand customer requirements, technical specifications and project scope.

- Develop practical mechanical concepts by evaluating feasibility, functionality, safety, cost and maintainability.

- Participate confidently in project discussions and present design concepts for internal and customer approval.

- Identify technical challenges early and propose innovative solutions.

\*\*B. Mechanical Design and 3D Modelling\*\*

- Develop detailed 3D models, assemblies and manufacturing drawings using SolidWorks.

- Design SPMs, fixtures, machine structures, mechanisms and fabricated assemblies.

- Use standard component libraries and existing 3D models wherever appropriate to reduce design time and improve standardization.

- Proficiently use 3D sketch and weldment/structural member tools.

- Define material properties and relevant attributes in 3D models.

- Ensure appropriate fits, clearances, tolerances and interfaces, considering manufacturability, assembly, safety and serviceability.

\*\*C. Manufacturing Documentation and BOM\*\*

- Prepare accurate manufacturing drawings and Bills of Materials for machined, fabricated, welded and purchased components.

- Generate weldment cut lists, internal part numbers and assembly documentation.

- Identify suitable suppliers and manufacturers for purchased and outsourced components.

- Prepare engineering calculations, sizing reports, analysis reports and lifecycle calculations where applicable.

- Maintain updated drawings, revision history and design records for easy retrieval and future reference.

\*\*D. Fabrication, Assembly and Project Coordination\*\*

- Coordinate with fabrication, machining and assembly teams to ensure designs are practical and manufacturing issues are resolved promptly.

- Clarify drawing requirements and incorporate necessary design changes to minimize rework and project delays.

- Work closely with electrical, controls, procurement and project teams to ensure successful system integration.

- Participate in design reviews and provide technical support during machine assembly and testing.

\*\*E. Cost Optimization and Design Quality\*\*

- Optimize component selection, material usage and manufacturing methods without compromising quality, safety or performance.

- Identify opportunities for cost reduction, component standardization and waste minimization.

- Ensure design accuracy and completeness before releasing drawings for manufacturing.

- Use engineering resources efficiently and incorporate lessons learned to improve future designs.

\*\*F. Installation and Customer Support\*\*

- Support installation, commissioning and troubleshooting of mechanical systems at customer sites.

- Interact professionally with customers during installation and after-sales service.

- Travel to customer locations when project requirements demand and help resolve mechanical issues.

- Strive to deliver solutions that meet or exceed customer expectations.

\*\*G. Innovation and Continuous Learning\*\*

- Take initiative in exploring new design concepts, mechanisms, tools and technologies.

- Stay updated on developments in mechanical design, SPMs, manufacturing processes and engineering software.

- Experiment with improved design methods and contribute to standardization and process improvement.

- Share technical knowledge and collaborate with colleagues on challenging projects.

\*\*H. Planning, Ownership and Teamwork\*\*

- Prioritize design activities, manage time effectively and meet agreed project deadlines.

- Identify resource requirements and take ownership of assigned deliverables.

- Adapt to changing project priorities and respond constructively under pressure.

- Maintain effective working relationships through clear communication, respect, collaboration and professional conduct.

### 4. Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications

\*\*Educational Qualification\*\*

- B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics.

- Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics may also be considered.

\*\*Mandatory Experience\*\*

- Minimum 3 years of professional mechanical design experience.

-Minimum of 2 years of Robotics Turn key solutions Mechanical Design experience is mandatory\*\*.

\*\*Technical Skills\*\*

- Strong proficiency in SolidWorks.

- Good understanding of SPM design principles, mechanisms, fixtures and machine structures.

- Knowledge of machining, fabrication, weldments, materials and manufacturing processes.

- Ability to develop concepts, 3D models, assemblies and detailed manufacturing drawings.

- Proficiency in BOM preparation, part numbering and weldment cut lists.

- Understanding of standard components, supplier selection and design for manufacturing and assembly (DFMA).

- Ability to perform relevant engineering calculations and prepare technical documentation.

\*\*Behavioural Competencies\*\*

- Strong analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills.

- Attention to detail and commitment to design quality.

- Ownership, accountability and effective time management.

- Cost-conscious decision-making without compromising quality.

- Willingness to learn, innovate and take on challenging assignments.

- Good communication and cross-functional coordination skills.

- Customer-focused approach and willingness to travel when required.

- Commitment to Innovation, Excellence and Integrity.

### 5. Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on:

- Quality, accuracy and timely completion of mechanical designs.

- Technical feasibility and approval of concepts.

- Reduction in design errors, rework and manufacturing issues.

- Accuracy of BOMs and completeness of engineering documentation.

- Cost optimization and effective use of standard components.

- Coordination with fabrication, assembly and project teams.

- Responsiveness during installation and customer-site support.

- Contribution to design standardization and continuous improvement.

### 6. Employment Expectations

This is a full-time position intended for a candidate seeking a long-term career in mechanical design and industrial automation.

The selected candidate is expected to take ownership of design deliverables, maintain high engineering standards, collaborate effectively across departments, continuously develop technical expertise and contribute to the successful execution of Synapse Robotics' projects.

### 7. Career Growth

The career path may progress as follows:

Progression will depend on technical competency, independent handling of complex designs, project ownership, innovation and contribution to team performance.

### 8. Benefits and Career Opportunities

- Opportunity to work on challenging SPM and robotic integration projects.

- Exposure to customized industrial automation solutions and high-end customers.

- Practical involvement in the complete project lifecycle, from concept development to installation.

- Opportunity to develop advanced SolidWorks and mechanical design expertise.

- Collaboration with experienced mechanical, electrical, controls and assembly teams.

- Career growth through technical specialization, increasing responsibility and leadership opportunities.

\*\*Join Synapse Robotics to transform ideas into innovative, reliable and efficient automation solutions and build a long-term career in mechanical design and industrial automation.\*\*
